authorization: User requested more cheese/Menger, Romeo-Juliet and Koch tests together; confirmed Koch snowflake and requested both passive relationship tracking and motion coupling.
scope: Local exploratory comparison. No publication of this new interaction model is authorized by this protocol.
fluid: Read existing original matched-stretch baseline fields only. Approved Navier-Stokes solver, Heun method and zero body force remain unchanged. No new fluid simulations.
geometry_matching: Every cloud has 192 distinct labels, zero initial centroid and RMS radius 0.15. The Menger cloud is a seeded subset of the 400 retained depth-2 cells. The Koch cloud has all 192 depth-3 vertices. The mixture uses 96 points from each. Sampling, embedding and dimension differ; this is not an isolated test of dimension. Holes are empty marker locations, not solid porous walls.
relationship_equation: dz_i/dt = a_i*z_i + b_i*sum_j P_ij(x)*z_j. Initial symmetric eight-nearest-neighbor graph includes all distance ties. Edge weights exp(-|r_ij|^2/(2*ell^2)) change with separation; P is row normalized. Edges remain between initial neighbors. For two connected nodes this is the Romeo-Juliet linear system.

opposing_responses.b: Equal counts +20 and -20, assigned with fixed seed 701. Network behavior is measured; the two-node center classification does not automatically apply.

initial_states: Three matched states using fixed seed 719: balanced uniform noise centered to zero; +0.2 plus that noise; exact negative of the positive state. These are three conditions, not independent experimental replicates.
motion_equation: dx_i/dt = u_saved(x_i,t) + mu/dbar0 * sum_j w_ij*tanh((z_i+z_j)/2)*r_ij. r_ij is shortest periodic displacement toward j. dbar0 is initial mean weighted degree. mu=0 is passive; mu=20 adds bounded signed attraction/repulsion coefficients. Pair contributions are equal and opposite, so their sum is zero. This is an overdamped particle drift rule, not a molecular force field or a self-consistent coupled Navier-Stokes model.
case_design: 5 geometries x 3 response profiles x 3 initial states x 2 motion couplings; 45 matched passive/active comparisons.
integrator: RK4 for positions and relationship states together; trilinear spatial and linear saved-time velocity interpolation. The pre-existing fluid solver remains Heun.
controls: all 90 cases at 64 grid, 32 steps per .01 snapshot interval
all 90 cases at 64 grid, 64 steps per .01 interval
all 90 cases at 128 grid, 64 steps per .01 interval
all 90 cases at 64 grid, velocity snapshots coarsened to .02 with 128 steps per interval
checks: Koch and Menger exact construction counts
two-person RK4 against matrix exponential for all three profiles
zero relationship state implies zero added drift
permutation invariance carrying coefficients, edges and states with labels
sum of added pair drifts is zero
reporting: Report active-minus-passive changes, state norms, cloud radius, initial-neighbor retention, minimum pair separation, step/grid/snapshot differences and all failed screens. No significance tests across the three different initial-state conditions.
limitations: Coefficients, graph rule and tanh motion coupling are chosen examples, not fitted water physics.
The added drift does not feed back on the saved fluid field and need not preserve tracer-cloud volume.
Original raw strain has nonsmooth periodic joins and unresolved peaks; 64/128 starting fields differ.
Finite labels and finite construction depth do not demonstrate a limiting fractal dimension.
A two-person saddle/center classification need not hold for an entire network.
No new Navier-Stokes regularity, molecular-personality, permanent-leader or real-water validation claim.
